title: 第21章 震惊四座第22章 婚事
slug: 天域丹尊第5904章不堪一击
content_zh:
第二十一章震惊四座
“这到底是什么武技，竟然如此霸道？”姜明豪心中骇然，苏尘使用的这门剑法武技，强得根本就不像是黄级低阶的剑法武技！
难道，是黄级中阶的剑法武技？
但，姜明豪来不及多想。
因为，苏尘已经足尖一点，朝他飞奔而来，手中长剑再次举起，杀意凛然。
姜明豪心中大骇，苏尘明显是要趁此机会，一鼓作气将他彻底击败。
他本想说“我认输”，但面对苏尘眼中那股凛冽杀意，姜明豪张了张嘴，“我认输”三个字竟然卡在了嗓子眼里，没能及时说出。
只能眼睁睁的看着苏尘又是一剑斩来！
“小尘！”
徐茵忍不住低呼一声，苏尘这一剑若是斩实了，姜明豪就算不死也重伤啊。
当！
便在这千钧一发之际，一柄长剑横空出现，将苏尘的剑死死架住。
苏尘侧眸望去，姜明轩的面容赫然映入眼帘，神色显得很是阴沉。
“苏尘，他已经输了，莫非你还要杀他不成？”姜明轩神情难看，刚才那一刻要不是他及时来救，姜明豪只怕真的会被苏尘一剑斩杀！
这可是在姜家的地盘，如果姜家的嫡系少爷被个外人给一剑斩了，姜家还不沦为全城的笑话！
苏尘淡然一笑，眼皮微微垂下，掩住那一丝嗜血的光芒，淡淡道：“比武中刀剑无眼，就算误杀也并非我的过错。况且你说他已经输了，但我可没听到他开口认输！”
说着，苏尘居高临下的看了眼已经吓得瘫在地上的姜明豪，道：“之前你说我是废物，现在你连我都打不过，岂不是连废物都不如？”
“你……”姜明豪脸上火辣辣的，好似被苏尘当面狠抽了一耳光，却偏偏无法反驳。
“比武还没结束，要不就开口认输，要不就站起来继续比！”苏尘云淡风轻道。
姜明豪可谓是进退两难，继续比，他根本不可能赢，还要冒着被苏尘斩杀的风险。

但要他开口认输，岂不是亲口承认自己连废物都不如？
一旁的姜明轩没忍住，轻蔑的讥讽道：“果然不愧是被宗门踢出来的弃徒，只会搞一些没用的东西！”
“哦？”苏尘慢条斯理的转头看向姜明轩，“听起来你倒是个有用的，要不，你代替他跟我继续比？”
“什么？”姜明轩差点以为自己听错了，“你要跟我比？”
别说姜明轩，就连在场其他人，也都以为自己的耳朵出了问题，引气境八重要跟引气境九重比武？
姜明轩一向骄傲，被一个比自己修为整整低一重的人挑战，对他来说无异于侮辱一般，
当下，姜明轩想也不想，就要拒绝。
但便在此时，姜明轩却听见耳边响起自己父亲姜山那细小的声音。
“明轩，跟他比！”
姜明轩侧眸望去，只见姜山站在不远处，正在望着他。
姜明轩知道，这是姜山在使用“聚音成线”的武技在和自己说话，这样说话其他人听不到，只有姜明轩能听到。
一瞬间，姜明轩就领悟了姜山的意图。
趁这个机会，正好可以将赌局挽回！
“好，我代替明豪和你继续比！但如果你输了，那五百颗小元丹就不给二房了。”姜明轩道。
content_en:
Chapter 21 Shocked everyone
"What kind of martial arts is this that is so domineering?" Jiang Minghao was shocked. The swordsmanship and martial arts used by Su Chen were so powerful that they didn't look like low-level yellow-level swordsmanships and martial arts!
Could it be that it is a yellow-level intermediate swordsmanship and martial arts?
However, Jiang Minghao had no time to think too much.
Because, Su Chen was already on tiptoe and was running toward him, raising the sword in his hand again with killing intent.
Jiang Minghao was horrified. Su Chen obviously wanted to take this opportunity to defeat him completely.
He wanted to say "I surrender", but facing the murderous intent in Su Chen's eyes, Jiang Minghao opened his mouth, but the words "I surrender" got stuck in his throat and he could not say it in time.
He could only watch helplessly as Su Chen struck with another sword!
"Xiaochen!"
Xu Yin couldn't help but cry out, if Su Chen's sword was a real strike, Jiang Minghao would be seriously injured even if he didn't die.
when!
At this critical moment, a long sword appeared across the sky and held Su Chen's sword tightly.
Su Chen looked sideways, and Jiang Mingxuan's face suddenly came into view, and his expression looked very gloomy.
"Su Chen, he has lost, do you still want to kill him?" Jiang Mingxuan looked ugly. If he hadn't come to the rescue in time just now, Jiang Minghao would have been killed by Su Chen's sword!
This is the territory of the Jiang family. If the direct young master of the Jiang family is killed by an outsider with a sword, the Jiang family will become the joke of the whole city!
Su Chen smiled indifferently, his eyelids drooped slightly, covering up the trace of bloodthirsty light, and said calmly: "The sword has no eyes in the competition, even if it is accidentally killed, it is not my fault. Besides, you said he has lost, but I didn't hear him admit defeat!"
As he said that, Su Chen looked down at Jiang Minghao, who was paralyzed on the ground with fear, and said, "You said I was a waste before, but now you can't even beat me, aren't you worse than a waste?"
"You..." Jiang Minghao's face was burning, as if he had been slapped hard by Su Chen in front of his face, but he couldn't refute.
"The competition is not over yet. Either admit defeat or stand up and continue the competition!" Su Chenyun said lightly.
Jiang Minghao was in a dilemma. If he continued to compete, it would be impossible for him to win, and he would risk being killed by Su Chen.
But for him to admit defeat, wouldn't it mean personally admitting that he is worse than trash?
Jiang Mingxuan on the side couldn't hold back and sneered contemptuously: "As expected, he is an abandoned disciple who was kicked out by the sect. He can only do some useless things!"
"Oh?" Su Chen slowly turned to look at Jiang Mingxuan, "It sounds like you are useful. How about you continue to compete with me in his place?"
"What?" Jiang Mingxuan almost thought he heard wrongly, "You want to compete with me?"
Not to mention Jiang Mingxuan, even everyone else present thought there was something wrong with their ears. The eighth level of the Qi-entraining realm was going to compete with the ninth level of the Qi-entraining realm?
Jiang Mingxuan has always been proud, so being challenged by someone whose cultivation level is one level lower than his own is tantamount to an insult to him.
At that moment, Jiang Mingxuan refused without even thinking about it.
But at this moment, Jiang Mingxuan heard the small voice of his father Jiang Shan ringing in his ears.
"Mingxuan, compare with him!"
Jiang Mingxuan looked sideways and saw Jiang Shan standing not far away, looking at him.
Jiang Mingxuan knew that this was Jiang Shan using the martial art of "concentrating sound into threads" to talk to him. In this way, no one else could hear his words, and only Jiang Mingxuan could hear them.
In an instant, Jiang Mingxuan understood Jiang Shan's intention.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, you can save the gamble!
"Okay, I will continue the competition with you on Minghao's behalf! But if you lose, the five hundred Little Yuan Dan will not be given to the second room." Jiang Mingxuan said.
